cz: 政策对本国所有村庄生效。公有制与私有制二选一；家庭经营的收获仍进入村庄仓库。
en: Policies apply to all villages in this nation. Choose one land system; family harvests still enter village stores.

cz: 调整后点击应用；详细参数仍在村庄窗口设置。
en: Apply to save changes. Configure local details in the village window.

cz: 全世界共用；默认6秒。范围0.1–86400秒；按1倍速计算并随暂停及倍速变化。一天12时；改动保留日期与年龄。
en: Shared by the whole world. Default: 6 seconds; range: 0.1–86400 at 1×. Follows game speed and pause. Each day has 12 hours; dates and ages are preserved.
Choose a village for local settings

cz: 已应用国家政策和世界日长。
en: National policies and world day length applied.

cz: 草稿尚未应用；点击“应用”后生效。
en: Draft not applied. Click Apply to activate these changes.

cz: 政策忠诚度修正：已生效 {0} → 草稿 {1}；固定加减不逐月累积。
en: Policy loyalty: active {0} → draft {1}. A fixed modifier; it does not accumulate over time.

cz: 入学年龄请输入1至100之间的整数；成年后不再安排儿童课程。
en: Enter an admission age from 1 to 100. Adult residents no longer receive children's lessons.

cz: 日长请输入0.1至86400之间的秒数。
en: Enter a day length between 0.1 and 86400 seconds.

cz: 本国未启用对应政策；参数可保存供启用后使用。
en: This policy is disabled. Settings are retained for when it is enabled.

cz: 三级战团已关闭；当前采用原版军队行为。
en: Three-tier organization is disabled; this army uses native behavior.

cz: 村庄围绕风车统一开垦和耕作。切换后保留已有家庭田中的作物；空田逐步退出。
en: Villages use native farming around windmills. Existing family crops remain for harvest; empty family plots are released.

cz: 有农民的家庭在城区附近经营矩形田块。可设置起步宽高与每户面积；不清除切换前的作物。
en: Farming families work rectangular plots near town. Configure initial width and height and household area. Switching preserves existing crops.

cz: 允许达到原版工作门槛的孩童生产（默认8岁）。关闭后仅成年人生产；不允许未成年人入伍。
en: Allow children to produce from the native work age (8 by default). When disabled only adults produce. Children cannot enlist.

cz: 普通居民按村庄月历工作或休息。农时与紧急防卫可例外；管理者及特殊者仍自由活动。关闭后全年可工作。
en: Ordinary residents follow village work months with seasonal and defense exceptions. Managers and special residents remain free. Disable for year-round work.

cz: 按物资和人口自动分配或手动指定各职业人数；农闲可临时支援。关闭后恢复原版职业分配并保留配置。
en: Allocate jobs from resources and population or set staffing manually. Farmers can help other jobs between seasons. Disable to use native staffing; settings are retained.

cz: 每村唯一Army采用全国统一的三级编制；按军功任命并列队操练巡逻。关闭后恢复原版军队；保留军功与配置。
en: Each village's single Army uses national unit sizes and names with merit appointments and formations. Disable for native army behavior; merit and settings remain.

cz: 冬麦9–11月播种且次年5–6月收；春麦3–4月播种且7–9月收。农时可打断休息。关闭后恢复原版生长与全年播收。
en: Winter wheat: sow Sep–Nov and harvest May–Jun. Spring wheat: sow Mar–Apr and harvest Jul–Sep. Seasonal work can interrupt rest. Disable for native growth and year-round farming.

cz: 收获原粮后送往风车加工成食物。关闭后直接收获可食用麦粮；已有原粮仍可加工。
en: Harvest raw grain and process it at a windmill. Disable to harvest edible wheat directly; existing raw grain can still be processed.

cz: 未成熟小麦每株施肥一次并在收获时增加一倍基础产量。关闭后仅对不受农时限制的作物恢复原版催熟；已有增产保留。
en: Fertilize each unripe plant once for double base yield. Disable for native ripening on crops without seasonal limits. Previously earned yield bonuses remain.

cz: 允许建筑使用农田地表；内城扩张使家庭田退耕且成熟作物可最后收取一次。关闭后恢复原版农田地表建造限制。
en: Buildings may use farmland. Inner-town expansion retires family plots with a final ripe harvest. Disable to restore native farmland construction restrictions.

cz: 允许无住房的本国居民到本城空置住宅内睡觉；仅临时借宿且不改变住房归属。没有可用空房时仍露宿。默认关闭。
en: Homeless residents may sleep in empty homes in their own town. Temporary shelter does not change home ownership. Without an available home they sleep outdoors. Disabled by default.

cz: 适龄孩童空闲时进入本村图书馆阅读城市藏书。童工任务优先；书籍和功法沿用原有学习效果与资格。默认关闭。
en: Eligible children read town books inside a local library when idle. Work comes first. Books and cultivation manuals keep their existing effects and requirements. Disabled by default.
